text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's communications minister says annual subscription for mobile telephones to be halved to 50 dinars as of December.
- Government to resign on Tuesday after the announcement of results in parliamentary election. Voting started on Monday to elect 50 new MPs in the second election since the 1991 Gulf War.
- Kuwait Investment Company says it will merge with Kuwait Foreign Trade, Contracting and Investment Company (KFTCIC) to form the first Kuwaiti investment bank.
- Water technology exhibition to be held on October 19.
- Kuwaiti women to stage a sit-in and a silent march on Monday to demand political rights. Women are not allowed to run for parliament or vote.
